name: clay-m
note: Abstract style 'clay figure' (VD/ABSTRACT-AND-WARDROBE.md section 1) of body-clay: same vertex order, shape space, joints, weights, dofs and poses; B5's lids (open, tapered onto the ball) and lid joints; blank sculpted eyeballs, gaze level; B6's last with the dressed style's 28 mm sole; neutralised chest (girth kept), navel, groin and cleft; welded mouth (lower lip tucked under the upper); softened face and ears; nails softened; the whole body subdivided once (round 4); one satin material; shape baked on the CPU.

RELAXED_STAND.note: clip frame per body (arms solved per body); `dofs` is one dof set that holds on every person of this package (arms at the widest body's abduction), for a renderer that needs a dof pose (pose overrides such as C6)

MOVE_STAND.source: CMU take 07_01; MOVE_STAND (round 8): an upright walk, CMU 07_01's cleanest cycle (source frames 18-51 at 30 fps, seam closed) walked on for 4.5 cycles (4.95 s, about 7 m); the eight packet frames fall on eight different phases of the step

seat.pose: operate8 frame 0; back measured along the backrest normal
seat.rule: round 6b (default, coordinator's decision: seated dimensions first): hip_above_pan_m puts the seated eye height at the person's survey value (manifest measure eyeheightsitting, a hard seat) less the cushion's own compression (cushion_compress_m, 20 mm: a firm 80 mm foam cushion deflecting about a quarter of its thickness; believed), in the operator posture (trunk reclined 10 degrees; the survey sits erect). The buttock and thigh skin then sinks deeper into the drawn pan (sink_mm) for the contact flatten to show as compressed tissue. Option seat_rule 'compression': hip_above_pan_compression_m, the deepest skin compress_rule_m (15-25 mm by BMI) into the pan. Pan top at the survey popliteal height in both (pan_drop_m).
seat.depth_rule: seat depth = buttock-popliteal length - 50 mm (survey buttock-knee length x 0.81, the buttock-popliteal / buttock-knee ratio of both sexes in ANSUR-type surveys; believed, not looked up), never deeper than the rig (front edge 0.38 m ahead of the hip centre)

motion.note: B4: per packet person, collision capsules (joint-relative, rest world axes, metres) and seated tissue extents for viewer/src/operator.ts; a body is matched to a person by `key` (rest head and left-hand joint positions)

skin8.semantics: self-contained 8-influence set, heaviest first, sum 1; JOINTS_0 / WEIGHTS_0 are the separate 4-influence fit

motion_block.note: merge into the package manifest: `clips` replaces the empty list, `packet.clips` the empty block, `packet.poses.RELAXED_STAND` REPLACES the builder's own RELAXED_STAND (round 6). MOVE_STAND is captured (CMU 86_15); IDLE_STAND is the relaxed stand under a procedural layer (not a captured idle). Clips named operate8 / demo30 switch the seated-operator plug-in on (viewer/src/operator.ts), which re-solves them live on the current body and draws the stand-in rig.

last.skinning: eight influences and _DQS from the body under it

style.switch: same topology and joints as the body package: v_style(shape) = N(A v(shape)); style.npz holds the base offset and the per-target offsets on the 19,158-row hm08 array; joints differ from the bare body by +soleHeight in y and by B5's eye centres and lid joints, as in the dressed package
style.eyes: blank (the incised iris was vetoed in VD/REVIEW-03 and is no longer built)
